items.name: Healing Rite
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, once you're out of slots.
items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-9,600 (levels 1-16). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Flying Slash T3, Shadow Transformation unlocked. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Spirit Snatch. Ultimate (Shadow Transformation) is available from Stalker.

items.name: Restorative Shot
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary, sold when you buy Spirit Burn later.

items.name: Melee Lifesteal
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Lifestrike, 10400 souls (~10.4 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Lifestrike, 9600 souls (~9.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Spirit Strike
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Spirit Snatch completes 5,600 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Spirit Snatch completes 4.8k spirit in 5600 souls (~5.6 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Stalker
items.why: weapon investment only and the build never reaches the 4.8k weapon tier through the core: timing review

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 33.3 to Power Slash's full charge damage (1.85x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling.

items.name: Spirit Snatch
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 spirit power. Upgrade of Spirit Strike (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Healing Booster
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Lifestrike completes 2,400 souls on. Upgrade of Extra Regen (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Lifestrike completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 9,600-27,200 (levels 16-29). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Power Slash T3, Crimson Slash T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Power Slash, full charge damage) grows from 279 to 654. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Lifestrike.

items.name: Lifestrike
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Melee Lifesteal (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Recharging Rush
items.why: weapon investment only and the build never reaches the 4.8k weapon tier through the core: timing review

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Extra Health
items.why: vitality investment only; its 8k tier completes at Colossus, 29600.0 souls (~29.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Torment Pulse
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 70.5 to Power Slash's full charge damage (2.35x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 8,800 to 13,600 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.caption: Power Slash (654) clears its 165-damage trigger. Takes spirit from 13,600 to 16,000 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Burst (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 16,000 to 22,400 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.caption: One Power Slash hit (758) alone passes the 500 spirit-damage trigger. Takes spirit from 22,400 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power. Replaces Restorative Shot: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Colossus
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 7,200 to 12,800 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 42 to 50 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Lifestrike? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Stalker.
sections.desc: Dying after Lifestrike? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Stalker.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult you can see coming, like Lash's or Infernus's.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Hexes and slows stop you getting in.

items.name: Reactive Barrier
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Stuns keep catching you on the way in.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry is out-shooting you.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit.

items.name: Healbane
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Their team heals a lot. Spirit Burn does this job late, so sell it then.

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Spirit Lifesteal for 4,800 more souls: bonus fire rate 0 to 25; bonus spirit lifesteal 0 to 10..

items.name: Diviner's Kevlar
items.caption: Casting Shadow Transformation gives a 1,000 barrier and +40 spirit for 20s, available once per ultimate cooldown (150s at your current ultimate tier), so it is a once-per-fight burst of defence. Takes vitality from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 182s of base cooldown across your kit, 150s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Replaces Recharging Rush: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Healing Tempo
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Healing Booster for 4,800 more souls: bonus fire rate 0 to 35; tech resist 0 to 10..
